title: Erdemium Adventures Preview Data Packs
description: Try out beta features of Erdemium Adventures before they get added to the mod officially!
body:
###  Try out beta features of Erdemium Adventures before they get added to the mod officially!

Download **Erdemium Adventures** mod **[here](https://modrinth.com/mod/erdemium-adventures)**!
